release_notes: Build 135 makes SQLite the source of truth for global Factburst Quiz Manager settings so reinstall/update file loss no longer resets saved configuration.
Existing settings.json, Autopilot preferences and tracker settings are migrated into the database automatically on first read; JSON files remain compatibility mirrors only.

Settings saved from the UI, Resolve quiz export preferences, Autopilot target/on-off state, API credentials, approved publishing destinations and tracker configuration now persist through the database-backed settings layer.
Sensitive credentials remain encrypted with the existing Windows local secret protection before they are written to SQLite.
